cycles.dpi_check: DPI records the phase and later checks issued_commands_o.
cycles.responsibility: Select the next TinyLlama linear tile command.
Present cmd_valid_o and hold the payload stable.
Accept the command when cmd_ready_i is high.
Wait for the first array progress beat.
Wait for the second array progress beat.
Wait for the third array progress beat.

cycles.dpi_check: DPI drives array_done_i in this phase.
cycles.responsibility: Sample array_done_i or array_error_i for the command.

cycles.dpi_check: DPI checks the accepted command count.
cycles.responsibility: Advance layer/op/tile counters for the next command.

output_signals.name: done_o

output_signals.description: Current linear op index within the layer.
output_signals.name: op_index_o

cycles.dpi_check: DPI records the composed engine phase.
cycles.responsibility: Start the scheduler/latch/array composition.

cycles.dpi_check: DPI records valid before array valid.
cycles.responsibility: Expose the ungated scheduler command-valid.
Gate the command into the systolic array.
Present the first latched stream beat to the array.
Stage or forward the next stream beat.
Continue array input transfer.
Observe the systolic-array completion pulse.
Return the composition to ready for the next tile.

Continue array input transfer.
Observe the systolic-array completion pulse.
Finish the slot or advance to its next tile.
